text:
ivy-rep: Hi team — Helion Care wants a hosted demo key for an on-site POC next Thu. Needs chat + embeddings, single laptop key, IP allowlist (3 office IPs), TTL 36-48h preferred, billing tag 'poc/helion', and a one-page rotate/revoke playbook for their security reviewer.

juan-eng: We can cut an ephemeral hosted key scoped to chat+embeds. Security typically enforces 24h, but ops can make 48h on case-by-case. I'll pre-create a standby key and put both in 1Password. Send IPs + demo contact.

ivy-rep: IPs: 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.11, 192.0.2.12. Contact: demoops@helion.example.com. They really prefer 48h to avoid mid-demo rotation.

maria-sec: FYI: hosted keys are controlled in Redwood control plane (no per-tenant KMS by default). If they require KMS wrapping, that's an enterprise Private/Dedicated feature — mark as blocker in the security questionnaire and offer a Private eval. For the questionnaire include: console activity CSV (create, rotate, revoke), screenshot of key metadata, and the rotation playbook.

juan-eng: Example API we'll use (admin token redacted):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"name":"poc-helion-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":172800,"rate_limit":15,"allowlist_ips":["192.0.2.10","192.0.2.11","192.0.2.12"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/helion","contact":"demoops@helion.example.com"}}'
```

vault-bot: key created: hosted_poc_helion_2098765432  created_by: juan-eng  expires_in: 172800s  scopes: chat, embeddings  rate_limit:15 req/s

ivy-rep: Perfect — can you also add a short note in the playbook about immediate revocation steps in case the laptop is lost? Customer asks for explicit steps.

maria-sec: Playbook bullets to include: 1) Revoke key via Console or API revoke endpoint, 2) Rotate standby key into 1Password, 3) Export Console Activity CSV and share with customer security contact, 4) For KMS requirement escalate to Solutions Eng for Private trial. Revoke example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_poc_helion_2098765432/revoke \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

ops: I've uploaded the key screenshot and a redacted Activity CSV to the deal vault and tagged billing as 'poc/helion'.

vault-bot: key revoked: hosted_poc_helion_2098765432  revoked_by: juan-eng  revocation_time: 2098765480

ivy-rep: Thanks — shared the playbook and CSV with the customer security reviewer. They accepted 48h for the demo window. Closing prep. :white_check_mark:
